title: In this town, every house turns on its Christmas lights on December 1st

lines.text: In this town, every house turns on its Christmas lights on December *first*. Every single one.
The mayor lights a *giant* tree. The baker covers his whole roof in candy canes.
Except *one* house. Old Mister Santos's house stays *dark*.
Every year. The kids call him the *Grinch*.
He keeps a box by his window that says, *hers*.
Every December, he buys *one* light bulb, and never uses it.
And every night he waves at our house, but he never *smiles*.
So I asked my mom why.
She said his wife put up their lights for *forty* years.
That night, I knocked on *every* door on our street.
The baker came. The mayor came. Even the kids who called him the *Grinch*.
When Mister Santos opened his door the next evening, his whole house was *glowing*.
He didn't say a word. He went back inside, and came out with that *one* bulb.
He screwed it in, right above his door. And for the first time, he *smiled*.
In this town, every house turns on its lights. Even the ones that *forgot* how.
